summary: The app builds and launches showing a NavigationView with all 7 scenario titles listed. However, navigating to ANY scenario page throws XamlParseException because SharedContent/xaml/Styles.xaml (defining SampleHeaderTextStyle, ScenarioDescriptionTextStyle) was never migrated into the WinUI 3 app's ResourceDictionary. This single omission causes 100% scenario content failure. Score: 21/100 (only shell/navigation chrome earns points).
